subject: Vendor portal handoff and evidence checklist for Vendr onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@vendrsecurity.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal onboarding — initial handoff and evidence checklist

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking this on — welcome to Vendr's security onboarding. To get your profile fully validated in our portal we typically need the items below. If you can assign an owner internally (legal or infosec usually), we'll start a quick review and unlock the CAIQ mapping for you.

Required for initial enrollment:
- Completed enrollment CSV (I attached a template)
- Latest SOC 2 snapshot (PDF) — public evidence is fine; we can accept redacted docs if needed
- Contact for portal admin + SSO email (SAML metadata if available)
- Technical contact for evidence follow-ups (usually an engineer)

Optional but speeds review:
- Screenshot of OneTrust/Vendr permission settings (admin role)
- Network diagram or dataflow doc for in-scope services

I've attached the enrollment template and a short checklist. Once you upload the SOC2 snapshot to the portal and confirm admin permissions we’ll map controls to SIG/CAIQ and come back with any gaps.

Timeline: most enrollments complete in 4–10 business days after we have the SOC2 and SSO details.

Best,
Elena Morales
Vendor Onboarding Lead — Vendr
[Attachment: EnrollmentForm_Vendr.csv (csv)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@vendrsecurity.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Oct 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal onboarding — initial handoff and evidence checklist

Thanks Elena — looping in Marissa (security ops) and Karthik (platform) who will drive the uploads. Quick answers:

- Owner: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai)
- SOC2: we can provide a redacted snapshot — Marissa will attach in a follow up
- SSO: we run Okta — Karthik will share SAML metadata and add Vendr as an app (requesting admin add)

Marissa / Karthik — can you confirm you got the enrollment CSV and SOC2 PDF by EOD Monday? Also please confirm who will be portal admin so Elena can invite them.

Marcus
VP, Platform — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@vendrsecurity.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal onboarding — initial handoff and evidence checklist

Hi Elena — attaching the SOC2 snapshot and a screenshot of the OneTrust/Vendr admin permission screen. I redacted customer names per our policy (see redaction table in the SOC2 PDF).

Attachments:
- SOC2_snapshot_2025.pdf (redacted)
- onetrust_permissions_screenshot.png

Notes:
- I've created a service account to be the Vendr portal admin: vendr-admin@redwood.ai (Okta SCIM provisioner ready).
- Karthik will upload the SAML metadata to your app request; his team handles technical evidence follow-ups.

Please confirm when you've received the files in the portal and publish the initial CAIQ mapping so we can schedule any follow-ups.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2_snapshot_2025.pdf (pdf)] [Attachment: onetrust_permissions_screenshot.png (png)]

From: Elena Morales <elena@vendrsecurity.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vendr Portal Support <support@vendr.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 14:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal onboarding — initial handoff and evidence checklist

Thanks Marissa — confirmed. I uploaded the SOC2 snapshot and the permissions screenshot to your Vendr profile and started the CAIQ auto-map. A couple of quick follow-ups:

- We flagged two controls that need clarification (encryption-at-rest key rotation policy and backup retention for analytics). I'll add comments in the portal; Karthik, can your team drop a short note or attach the backup retention policy (pdf) to the control?
- I sent an invite to vendr-admin@redwood.ai with admin permissions. Please accept from Okta and confirm.

Portal link: https://vendr.onetrust.app/portal/ORG-98765/profile (you should see the new evidence under "Uploaded Files")

Once the two clarifications are uploaded we'll move this to "Verified" and finalize the CAIQ export. Expect a short follow-up from our mapping team within 48 hours.

Elena
Vendor Onboarding Lead — Vendr
[Portal action: SOC2_snapshot_2025.pdf uploaded]
